title: extractSignerCert matches on serial number only — RFC 5652 §10.2.3 requires issuer+serial
rationale: Added bytes.Equal(cert.RawIssuer, ias.Issuer.FullBytes) conjunct to match condition in extractSignerCert; bytes package already imported. Covers both VerifyTimestamp and VerifyTimestampTrusted which share this function.
variants_checked: rfc3161.go:extractSignerCert — sole cert-selection function; both VerifyTimestamp and VerifyTimestampTrusted call it; no other SerialNumber.Cmp in the package. Note: extractIntermediateCerts uses serial-only exclusion at line 395 — separate concern, lower severity, should be tracked separately.
bypass_considered: Attacker cert with matching serial but different issuer DN: bytes.Equal fails on raw DER mismatch; defeating the check requires a cert from the same CA with the same serial (CA key compromise scenario)
test_note: TestVerifyTimestamp_SerialOnlyCollision added to rfc3161_verify_test.go: decoy cert with matching serial listed first, legitimate cert second; fix selects correct cert and signature verifies
review_reason: Both hunks strictly on the extractSignerCert → VerifyTimestamp/VerifyTimestampTrusted call path. Production fix adds issuer DN comparison as required by RFC 5652 §10.2.3 — genuine root cause fix, not suppression. No new parsing, trust extension, or check removal. Regression test constructs genuine end-to-end collision token with decoy cert first.
